title: Appointments to the East Maui water board
summary: On August 4, the committee heard from a farmer applying for a council-appointed East Maui board seat, who stressed that people come first in water decisions and that farmers cannot grow food without water. A resolution approving him is to go on the August 12 council agenda. In February, the committee voted six to two to recommend appointing the Hawaiian Homes Commission's representative to the East Maui Regional Community Board.
